string.text: Keep those hands to yourself, buddy.
Try that again and you won't like what happens.
What do you think you're doing back there?
Lost something? Get your mitts off my gear!
Careful where you reach, stalker.
You could simply ask for some spare change, beggar.
The hell you reaching into my pockets for, %player_name%?
People used to get their hands cut off for this, you know?
Keep your fucking hands to yourself, "friend".
I can't wait to tell the rest about you pickpocketing our guys.
You're really trying to make yourself enemies for a few rubles, pal?
Wait, I know you...
Go ahead, fuck up a few times more. We'll make sure to spread the word around.
Oh, dude... The Zone is that rough on you, %player_name%? Shame I'm not a fucking charity.
I swear, we need to make our shit digital. Get bent, %player_name%.
Motherfucker... You're really amusing. This isn't a goddamn video game, people get killed for less here, bud.
Dude, just... get lost.
This is my cash. Do I need to spell it out for you, dipshit?
Alright, fucker, you're done!
Who- what?! Hey, get him!
You're so fucking dead, %player_name%!
Oh, you fucking thief!
Of course its you, %player_name%!
How about you now go and cry to Riisn like a little bitch you are?!
Alright, the safe word is 'Zone brutality'!
Stop right there, you criminal scum!
You have committed crimes against Zone and her people and you'll pay with your blood!
I call this a difficulty tweak!
